summary: Recent updates in the **compositing and layers** area of Firefox enhance the way scroll events are handled and improve performance when rendering graphics. Notably, the browser now _eagerly_ snapshots the scroll state through ScrollTimeline, which allows for more responsive interactions and smoother animations during scrolling. Additionally, a new preference has been added to adjust autoscroll speed, tailoring the experience to individual users. Improvements to how the browser manages and synchronizes visual and layout scroll offsets help ensure a seamless browsing experience, particularly when navigating content that involves complex layering or rendering techniques. These changes collectively aim to make scrolling more efficient and visually appealing for users.
